clue.text: Distinguished group with a role to play

parts.note: a set is a group of people or things
an actor's part is the role to play

explanation.surface: A notable troupe in which everyone has a role to perform.
explanation.definitionFit: Something marked out as different from the rest is distinguished, an adjectival sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Plots get insurgent in awful mess

indicators.note: in places the rebel inside the reshuffled letters
awful suggests a mess made worse, so the letters of mess are disordered

parts.note: Che Guevara was a famous insurgent

explanation.surface: Conspiracies place a rebel in a terrible muddle.
explanation.walkthrough: Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary, is the crossword's stock insurgent.
explanation.definitionFit: Plots and schemes are both secret plans, synonyms.

clue.text: Martyrs here, having originally tried organising labourers, taken over water

indicators.note: in a down answer, taken over places the first piece above the second
originally takes the initial letters of each of the three words

parts.note: a puddle is a small pool of water

explanation.surface: A story of martyrs who first tried organising farm workers and were transported over the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tolpuddle Martyrs were Dorset farm labourers transported to Australia in 1834 for forming a union, an early trade-union cause.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dorset village gave its name to the famous Martyrs, so it is where they were.

clue.text: Company importing wine has means of deferring payment

indicators.note: importing means bringing in, so the company letters take in the wine

parts.note: PLC is a public limited company
Asti is an Italian sparkling wine

explanation.surface: A firm that imports wine offers a way to pay later.
explanation.definitionFit: Credit cards are known colloquially by their material, a way to buy now and pay later.

clue.text: More willing to be first person in book

indicators.note: in tells us the pronoun goes inside the book word

parts.note: a reader is a book for learning to read
I is the first-person pronoun

explanation.surface: Someone is keener to be the narrator of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Readier is the comparative of ready, which means willing.

clue.text: Prize tree required fertiliser

parts.note: a pot is a trophy or prize, as in a pot won at a show
the ash is a common tree

explanation.surface: A gardener says a prize-winning tree needed feeding.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium carbonate compounds are widely used as a garden fertiliser rich in potassium.

clue.text: Composer with soft heart in capital for opening

indicators.note: opening says this piece comes at the start

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: in tells us the middle letters go inside the city

parts.note: Kiev is the capital of Ukraine

indicators.note: heart takes the middle letters of the word soft

explanation.surface: A soft-hearted composer in a capital at a premiere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' is the positional signal: the word for 'for' goes at the front. Kiev is the older spelling of Ukraine's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Prokofiev was a Russian composer of ballets and symphonies.

clue.text: Stumble across fish in disturbed sea

indicators.note: across means stretched over, so the stumble word goes round the fish

parts.note: to trip is to stumble
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Someone trips over a fish in rough water.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough water caused by opposing currents is a kind of disturbed sea.

clue.text: Boat with sides of acrylic resin

parts.note: a shell is a light racing rowing boat

indicators.note: sides are the outer edges, so the first and last letters of acrylic are taken

explanation.surface: A boat finished with acrylic coating on its sides.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a lac-based resin used to make varnish, so an example of a resin.

clue.text: Uproar when body is found by a bear

parts.note: the hull is the main body of a ship
Baloo is the bear in Kipling's The Jungle Book

explanation.surface: Panic breaks out when a corpse is discovered beside a bear.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy commotion or fuss is an uproar, a synonym.

clue.text: Animal hearing of honey?

indicators.note: what is heard is the spoken form, so the word for honey is taken by its sound

parts.note: honey is a term of endearment, like dear

explanation.surface: Which creature would you hear in a word of affection?
explanation.definitionFit: The stag or doe is a familiar hoofed animal.

clue.text: Variety of rue is not normal plant

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters of the following words take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A gardener complains that a strain of rue is an abnormal plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Variety of' rearranges the fourteen letters of RUE IS NOT NORMAL; 'plant' at the end is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an alpine perennial herb of the dock family, so a plant.

clue.text: Team in contact with RAC about motorbike attachment

parts.note: a side is a team in sport

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the club's initials are read the other way

explanation.surface: A team gets in touch with the motoring club over a motorbike add-on.
explanation.walkthrough: The RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motoring organisation; 'about' turns its letters to CAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-wheeled passenger car fixed to the side of a motorcycle is an attachment to it.

clue.text: Dolorous one in part of Scotland — he had to go under

indicators.note: in a down answer, going under places the pieces below what comes before
in puts the numeral inside the region's name

parts.note: Angus is a council area in east Scotland
I is one in Roman numerals
he had contracts to he'd

explanation.surface: A sorrowful man in a Scottish region had to go under.
explanation.walkthrough: Angus is a council area of eastern Scotland; in a down clue 'to go under' sets the contraction below, its apostrophe dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Dolorous means full of grief or pain, a literary synonym.

clue.text: A lot of beer or wine that's about nine pence

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the wine word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: sack is an old word for a dry white wine such as sherry
IX is nine in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A drinker weighs a batch of beer or wine costing around ninepence.
explanation.definitionFit: A pack of six cans or bottles is a quantity of beer bought together.

clue.text: Paris gave her an apple pie, hard to cut up

indicators.note: cut up means chopped into pieces, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Paris gave a woman a hard-to-cut apple pie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut up' rearranges PIE HARD TO. In Greek myth Paris awarded the golden apple to the goddess of love.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Judgement of Paris the Trojan prince handed the golden apple to the goddess of love.

clue.text: Leak from VP

parts.note: v. and p. are the abbreviations for vide (see) and page, so the letters come from two words meaning see and page

explanation.surface: Someone leaks a secret from the vice-president.
explanation.walkthrough: VP is usually vice-president; here v. is short for vide, Latin for see, and p. for page.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow escape of liquid through a gap is a leak.

clue.text: To improve, guys risk losing their heads

indicators.note: losing their heads removes the first letter from each word

parts.note: men are guys
to chance something is to risk it

explanation.surface: To get better, men must risk getting carried away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing their heads' drops the M from MEN and the C from CHANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to make it better, so to improve it.

clue.text: TV system on army base in Syrian city

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means placed above

parts.note: PAL is the analogue colour television system

indicators.note: base means debased or corrupted, so the letters of army are mixed

explanation.surface: Television equipment is installed on a military base in Syria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base' looks like a camp, but it signals a corrupted order of ARMY, giving MYRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Palmyra was an ancient oasis city in the Syrian desert.

clue.text: Woman in garden simulated a market town

parts.note: Eve is the woman in the Garden of Eden
sham means feigned or simulated

explanation.surface: A woman in a garden faked a whole market town.
explanation.walkthrough: EVESHAM is a market town in Worcestershire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an English town with a long-standing market, so an example of a market town.

clue.text: Old soldiers capture pennant finally that's over the top

indicators.note: capture means take hold of, so the soldiers word surrounds the letter

parts.note: ex means former or old
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of pennant

explanation.surface: Veterans seize a flag, which is going too far.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers are a British army corps, a common crossword source of soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive behaviour is over the top, and extreme means the same.

clue.text: English film director or English queen

parts.note: David Lean directed Lawrence of Arabia

explanation.surface: Asks whether an English director or an English queen is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleanor of Aquitaine and Eleanor of Castile were queens of England.

clue.text: Performer in ring somewhat taken in when gypsy turns up

indicators.note: taken in means held inside, so the small amount goes in the reversed word
in a down answer, turns up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Rom is a Romany gypsy
a tad means somewhat or a little

explanation.surface: A ring performer is a bit fooled when a gypsy arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' gives MOR, the reverse of ROM, and A TAD goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bullfighter performs in the bullring.

clue.text: Taking charge for a while, men engaged in stopping crime

parts.note: holding a player or ball means stopping it

indicators.note: engaged in means held inside, so the men go into the crime

parts.note: theft is a crime
OR (other ranks) are ordinary soldiers, the men

explanation.surface: Someone takes temporary command while officers are busy halting a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaged in' puts OR inside THEFT; OR, other ranks, is a military abbreviation for the men as opposed to officers.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means looking after things in someone's absence, temporarily taking charge.

clue.text: Black in Bluegrass State

parts.note: Kentucky is nicknamed the Bluegrass State, abbreviated KY

explanation.surface: Something is black in Kentucky.
explanation.definitionFit: Coloured like ink, so very dark or black.

clue.text: Contemplate asylum that accepts first of inmates needing care

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so the asylum word holds the letter

parts.note: a haven is a refuge or asylum

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of the inmates word

parts.note: to mind something is to care for it

explanation.surface: Consider a mental hospital that admits an inmate requiring treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'asylum' suggests a hospital but here means a haven, a place of safety.
explanation.definitionFit: To think about or intend something is to contemplate it.

clue.text: Look at road after changing gear

indicators.note: after puts the road abbreviation behind the reshuffled letters
changing alters the order of the letters of the word gear

explanation.surface: A driver watches the road after shifting gear.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard something is to look at or consider it, a synonym.

clue.text: Impressed by her, a bird expressed approval

indicators.note: impressed by means pressed into, so the pieces sit inside the word her

parts.note: the rhea is a large flightless South American bird

explanation.surface: A bird, struck by her, made approving noises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Impressed' suggests admiration, but it means pressed into; the rhea is a large flightless South American bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry used in Parliament and meetings is a spoken expression of approval or agreement.
